A window contractor specializes in the installation, replacement, and repair of residential and commercial windows. Services often include measuring and fitting, weatherproofing, energy-efficient upgrades, and custom window solutions tailored to your property’s needs. How do I know if I need new windows or just repairs? Signs you may need new windows include drafts, condensation between panes, difficulty opening or closing, or rising energy bills. Minor issues like damaged seals or hardware may only require repairs. A professional inspection can help determine the best solution. What should I look for when hiring a window contractor? Look for licensed and insured contractors with strong customer reviews, transparent pricing, and experience with your preferred window style or brand. Ask about warranties, timelines, and whether they handle permits and cleanup.
